_comment: Public descriptions for Fleet reference fields whose source text is missing or describes Fleet internals. The sources are the read-only libs/fleet mirror (CRD doc comments in sdk-schema, swag annotations in backend), so they cannot be edited here; fix them upstream in trycua/cloud and delete the entry. fleet.ts fails when a key no longer names a field.

OSGymSandboxWarmPool.spec.autoscaling: Claim-driven autoscaling. When set, Fleet sizes the pool from its live claims (Pending and Bound) and owns `spec.replicas`: a Pending claim grows the pool, deleting claims shrinks it. Absent: `spec.replicas` is a static size.
OSGymSandboxWarmPool.spec.autoscaling.initialPoolSize: Warm head start: `spec.replicas` starts here when the pool is created, so the first claims bind without a cold start. It then follows claim demand, never below `minPoolSize`.
OSGymSandboxWarmPool.spec.autoscaling.maxPoolSize: Most sandboxes the pool scales to.
OSGymSandboxWarmPool.spec.autoscaling.minPoolSize: Fewest warm sandboxes kept while autoscaling. `0` lets the pool scale to zero when there are no claims.
OSGymSandboxWarmPool.spec.replicas: Warm sandboxes to keep ready. With `autoscaling`, Fleet sets it.
OSGymSandboxWarmPool.spec.sandboxTemplateRef: The template the pool's sandboxes run.

OSGymSandboxClaim.spec.bindDeadline: Seconds the claim may stay Pending before it is marked Failed (Fleet's default and the SDK's value: 900). A Pending claim is what grows an autoscaled pool, so leave room for a cold boot.
OSGymSandboxClaim.spec.lifecycle: When the claim expires and what happens to its sandbox.
OSGymSandboxClaim.spec.lifecycle.autoRenew: Set by Fleet on claims it renews itself. Leave it `false`.
OSGymSandboxClaim.spec.lifecycle.shutdownPolicy: `Retain`: when the claim is deleted, the sandbox returns to the pool and restarts clean. `Delete`: the sandbox is destroyed and the pool creates a new one.
OSGymSandboxClaim.spec.lifecycle.shutdownTime: Absolute UTC expiry (RFC 3339). Fleet deletes the claim, and releases its sandbox, once it passes. Renew by patching it forward.
OSGymSandboxClaim.spec.sandboxTemplateRef: The template of the pool to claim from.
OSGymSandboxClaim.spec.warmpool: Where to take a sandbox from: `default` (the pool running the template), `none`, or a pool name.
OSGymSandboxClaim.status.sandbox.name: Name of the bound sandbox.
OSGymSandboxClaim.status.sandbox.service: In-cluster DNS name of the sandbox's Service.

OSGymSandboxTemplate.spec.vmTemplate.command: `gvisor` and `macos` only: entrypoint of the sandbox container, overriding the image's.
OSGymSandboxTemplate.spec.vmTemplate.containerDiskImage: The image: a containerDisk for `kubevirt`, a container image for `gvisor` and `macos`.
OSGymSandboxTemplate.spec.vmTemplate.firmware: VM firmware for `kubevirt`: `efi` for UEFI-only images such as Windows, `bios` for the Linux images.
OSGymSandboxTemplate.spec.vmTemplate.imagePullPolicy: `gvisor` and `macos` only: when to pull the image (default `IfNotPresent`).
OSGymSandboxTemplate.spec.vmTemplate.imagePullSecret: Secret in the pool's namespace with registry credentials for a private image. Omit it for a public image.
OSGymSandboxTemplate.spec.vmTemplate.memory: Memory per sandbox, as a Kubernetes quantity such as `8Gi`.
OSGymSandboxTemplate.spec.vmTemplate.nestedVirtualization: Expose hardware virtualization (KVM) inside the VM.
OSGymSandboxTemplate.spec.vmTemplate.nodeSelector: `gvisor` and `macos` only: node selector of the sandbox pod. Fleet's default fits the runtime.
OSGymSandboxTemplate.spec.vmTemplate.oidc: Workload identity: Fleet puts an OIDC access token for your account at `/var/run/cua/oidc/token` in the guest and keeps it fresh, so the workload can federate into AWS (`sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity`) or any other provider that trusts the token.
OSGymSandboxTemplate.spec.vmTemplate.oidc.awsRegion: AWS region for AWS SDK calls in the guest.
OSGymSandboxTemplate.spec.vmTemplate.oidc.awsRoleArn: When set, the guest's AWS SDK assumes this role with the token (environment and `~/.aws/config` are set up).
OSGymSandboxTemplate.spec.vmTemplate.oidc.credentialsSecret: Secret in the pool's namespace holding the client credentials (`client_id`, `client_secret`) that mint the token.
OSGymSandboxTemplate.spec.vmTemplate.oidc.refreshIntervalSeco: How often the guest refreshes the token (half its one-hour lifetime by default).
OSGymSandboxTemplate.spec.vmTemplate.oidc.tokenUrl: Token endpoint that mints the workload token.
OSGymSandboxTemplate.spec.vmTemplate.probes: Kubernetes `readinessProbe` and `livenessProbe` for the VM, so a sandbox counts as ready only when the guest serves.
OSGymSandboxTemplate.spec.vmTemplate.runtime: `kubevirt`: each sandbox is a VM booted from `containerDiskImage`. `gvisor`: a gVisor container of the image. `macos`: a macOS sandbox. For `gvisor` and `macos`, `firmware`, `cpuCores` and `memory` are advisory.
OSGymSandboxTemplate.spec.vmTemplate.runtimeClassName: `gvisor` and `macos` only: RuntimeClass of the sandbox pod. Fleet's default fits the runtime.
OSGymSandboxTemplate.spec.vmTemplate.services: Ports each sandbox publishes, as a Service named `<sandbox>-<name>`. Reach them through service URLs.
OSGymSandboxTemplate.spec.vmTemplate.tolerations: `gvisor` and `macos` only: tolerations of the sandbox pod. Fleet's default fits the runtime.

OSGymSandbox.status.resetIssuedAt: When Fleet began restarting the sandbox to return it to its pool.
OSGymSandbox.status.resetVmiUid: Identifies the VM instance that restart replaces.
OSGymSandbox.status.runtime: Runtime that provisioned the sandbox: `macos`, `gvisor`, or empty for `kubevirt`.
OSGymSandbox.status.service: In-cluster DNS name of the sandbox's Service.

handlers.CreateSignedServiceURLRequest.claim: The claim that holds the sandbox.
handlers.CreateSignedServiceURLRequest.expiresInSeconds: Lifetime of the URL, in seconds.
handlers.CreateSignedServiceURLRequest.label: A label for the URL, at most 120 UTF-8 bytes.
handlers.CreateSignedServiceURLRequest.logicalService: The service as the template names it, for example `env`.
handlers.CreateSignedServiceURLRequest.sandbox: The sandbox name (`status.sandbox.name` of the claim).

handlers.CreateUserKeyRequest.name: A name for the key.
handlers.CreateUserKeyRequest.scope: Namespaces the key is limited to.

handlers.CreateUserKeyResponse.client_secret: OAuth client secret. Returned once; it cannot be read again.
handlers.CreateUserKeyResponse.name: The key's name.
handlers.CreateUserKeyResponse.scope: Namespaces the key is limited to.
handlers.CreateUserKeyResponse.token_url: Token endpoint for the client-credentials grant.
